use_cases.name: Cradle-to-Grave Waste Compliance & Audit Readiness
use_cases.description: Centralize hazardous-waste compliance from generation through transportation, treatment, storage, and final disposal, enabling teams to reconcile manifests, monitor exceptions, validate waste profiles and LDR certifications, track generator-status thresholds, and maintain audit-ready evidence.

personas.name: EHS / Environmental Compliance Manager
personas.role: Owns cradle-to-grave RCRA compliance across sites; primary day-to-day user.

personas.name: Waste Coordinator / Generator
personas.role: Manages manifests, waste profiles, and generator-status thresholds at site level.

personas.name: Plant / Site Operations Manager
personas.role: Needs site-level generation volumes and permit-limit headroom.

personas.name: Regulatory Affairs / Permitting
personas.role: Tracks permit conditions, biennial reports, TCEQ/EPA filings, and deadlines.

personas.name: Internal Auditor
personas.role: Verifies manifest reconciliation and the evidence trail for audit readiness.

hero_questions.question: Which manifests in the last quarter show a discrepancy between quantity shipped and quantity received?
Are any sites exceeding their generator-status (LQG) threshold, and does the current permit cover that volume?
Which open manifests have not been returned within the 45-day exception-report window?
Which waste streams lack a current waste profile or valid Land Disposal Restriction (LDR) certification?
Which sites are approaching a biennial-report deadline with incomplete data?
What is the trend in hazardous-waste generation by EPA waste code across sites over 24 months?

kpis.name: Manifest reconciliation rate
kpis.definition: % of manifests where quantity received matches quantity shipped within tolerance.

kpis.name: Open-manifest aging
kpis.definition: % of manifests unreturned past the 45-day exception window; and average days-to-closure.

kpis.name: Generator-status headroom
kpis.definition: Each site's current hazardous-waste accumulation as a percentage of its regulatory LQG threshold.

kpis.name: Waste-profile currency
kpis.definition: % of active waste streams with a valid, non-expired profile and LDR certification.

kpis.name: Hazardous-waste generation volume
kpis.definition: Total tons generated by EPA waste code, by site, over the reporting period.

kpis.name: Regulatory-filing readiness
kpis.definition: % of required filings, including biennial and annual TCEQ filings, with complete underlying data ahead of deadline.

use_cases.name: Downstream TSDF & CERCLA Liability Risk
use_cases.description: Assess downstream environmental and contractual risk by connecting waste shipments, waste streams, volumes, TSDF compliance status, and disposal contracts to identify potential CERCLA exposure and rerouting requirements.

personas.name: EHS / Environmental Compliance Manager
personas.role: Owns cradle-to-grave RCRA compliance and evaluates downstream facility risk.

personas.name: Corporate Environmental Counsel
personas.role: Assesses CERCLA/successor liability from downstream TSDFs and reviews contract indemnities.

personas.name: Risk & Insurance Manager
personas.role: Quantifies environmental liability for reserves and coverage decisions.

personas.name: Regulatory Affairs / Permitting
personas.role: Monitors downstream facility regulatory and permit status.

hero_questions.question: Which hazardous-waste shipments in the last 12 months went to TSDFs now on the CERCLA/Superfund NPL or with open EPA enforcement actions?
What is our liability exposure if TSDF X loses its permit — which waste streams and what volume would need rerouting?
What do our TSDF disposal contracts say about indemnification and liability caps?
For any Ship Channel discharge/spill incident, which waste streams, transporters, and TSDFs are implicated?

kpis.name: Downstream facility compliance rate
kpis.definition: % of waste volume sent to TSDFs with no open enforcement action or NPL listing.

kpis.name: CERCLA liability exposure
kpis.definition: Estimated potential liability tied to waste sent to NPL- or enforcement-flagged facilities.

kpis.name: Hazardous-waste generation volume
kpis.definition: Total tons generated and shipped by EPA waste code, site, waste stream, and destination.

use_cases.name: Site, Transporter & Regulatory Risk Management
use_cases.description: Provide an enterprise view of site, transporter, generation, and regulatory risks so operations and compliance teams can identify threshold exceedances, transporter issues, generation trends, and upcoming filing obligations before they become violations or operational disruptions.

personas.name: EHS / Environmental Compliance Manager
personas.role: Monitors enterprise-wide hazardous-waste compliance and operational risk.

personas.name: Waste Coordinator / Generator
personas.role: Manages site-level waste generation, shipments, manifests, and transporter information.

personas.name: Plant / Site Operations Manager
personas.role: Monitors generation volumes and permit-limit headroom.

personas.name: Regulatory Affairs / Permitting
personas.role: Tracks regulatory filings, permit conditions, and compliance deadlines.

personas.name: Risk & Insurance Manager
personas.role: Evaluates environmental and operational risk exposure.

hero_questions.question: Are any sites exceeding their generator-status (LQG) threshold, and does the current permit cover that volume?
Which transporters we use have had DOT/PHMSA violations or an expired/invalid EPA ID number?
Which sites are approaching a biennial-report deadline with incomplete data?
What is the trend in hazardous-waste generation by EPA waste code across sites over 24 months?
For any Ship Channel discharge/spill incident, which waste streams, transporters, and TSDFs are implicated?

kpis.name: Generator-status headroom
kpis.definition: Each site's current hazardous-waste accumulation as a percentage of its regulatory LQG threshold.

kpis.name: Transporter compliance score
kpis.definition: % of shipments moved by transporters with valid EPA IDs and no active PHMSA violations.

kpis.name: Hazardous-waste generation volume
kpis.definition: Total tons generated by EPA waste code, site, and reporting period.

kpis.name: Regulatory-filing readiness
kpis.definition: % of required filings with complete underlying data ahead of the regulatory deadline.

kpis.name: Manifest reconciliation rate
kpis.definition: % of manifests where quantity received matches quantity shipped within tolerance.
